Made in the app for an order, numbered INV-<agent code>-<seq>, VAT 16% shown; PDF sent on WhatsApp, printable on a Bluetooth printer; pushed to SAP.
Payment mode through Airtel or MTN.
Quality team member who resolves customer complaints: investigates, fills Operator and Shift, writes the resolution note, sets the statuses.
Customer opinion recorded by a Sales Agent as a rating from 1 to 5 and an optional comment for each question in the Owner's fixed question list.
Monthly goal the Sales Head sets per Sales Agent, by value (ZMW) and by quantity per product group.
Monthly pay-out worked out in a report: 2% of sales value if target 100% or more achieved, 1% if 80 to 99%, none below 80%. Paid through payroll, not in the app.
Invoiced and Delivered orders of a Sales Agent in the month, before VAT; Cancelled not counted.
A market: a group of customers and staff. The Sales Head sends notices and promos to all staff of an Area.
A message the Owner or Sales Head posts on the Notice Board to All staff, an Area or a role; the poster can edit or remove it.
Read-only questions about sales, visits and attendance that the Owner, Sales Head, Area Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager ask and get answered from the data they may see.
Voice in English or Nyanja fills the Visit Book order or the Complaint form; the user checks and saves.
From a Modern Trade shelf photo, a suggested shelf share and missing products; the Sales Supervisor uses it.

requirements.title: Employee Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps an Employee Master with contact details, assigned Beats (multi select) and Casual, Sick and Total Leave Balance. Owner adds and edits Employees; they may also come from SAP.
acceptance: Owner adds an employee, picks one or more Beats, and Total Leave Balance shows Casual + Sick.

requirements.title: Customer Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Customer Master with the fields in RFP-1 §5.2, Category and Classification values, conditional TPIN, and Route filled from the chosen Beat. Owner maintains it; Sales Agents may add Customers through a Change Request.
acceptance: Owner adds a customer, picks a Beat, and the Route of that Beat fills in.
TPIN is a 10-digit ZRA Taxpayer ID, required for Wholesaler and Supermarket, optional for other categories.
A Sales Agent's new Customer reaches SAP only after Sales Supervisor approval of its Change Request.

requirements.title: Customer GEO Tagging
requirements.statement: Each Customer's location is captured by the Sales Agent on the first visit; only a Sales Supervisor may change it.
acceptance: A customer record shows its map location after tagging.
A Sales Agent cannot change a captured location; a Sales Supervisor can.

requirements.title: Product Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Product Master with Image, Product Code, Product, Case Size, Category (from Category Master) and Price.
acceptance: Owner adds a product with a Category from the Category Master and it can be picked in orders.

requirements.title: Beat and Route Masters
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Route Master and a Beat Master, each Beat linked to one Route; master records use Active/Inactive status and are not deleted.
acceptance: Owner adds a Route, then a Beat on that Route; the Beat shows its Route.

requirements.title: Store Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Store Master of modern trade stores with store name, store supervisor, email, supervisor mobile number, area name and location.
acceptance: A Store added to the Store Master can be picked in Modern Trade.

requirements.title: Category Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Category Master used to categorise products and competitor products.
acceptance: Categories added appear as choices in Product Master and Competitor Master.

requirements.title: Competitor Master
requirements.statement: The system keeps a Competitor Master: competitor name and its products (image, product code, product, case size, category).
acceptance: A competitor with products can be picked in Modern Trade competitor activities.

volumes.text: About 4,000 customers, 120 products, 100 employees; about 700 invoices a day.
Initial load from SAP: customers, products, employees, open balances per customer; no order history.
Sync every 30 minutes; invoices near real time.

requirements.title: Customer sync
requirements.statement: Customers created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; customers created or changed in neome go to SAP after the Sales Supervisor approves the Change Request; on a clash SAP wins.
acceptance: A customer added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
A new customer made in neome is not in SAP until the Sales Supervisor approves it, then it is.
A customer changed in both places shows the SAP value in neome.

requirements.title: Product sync
requirements.statement: Products created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; products made or changed in neome by the Owner are pushed to SAP direct; on a clash SAP wins.
acceptance: A product added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
A product added in neome by the Owner is in SAP after the push.

requirements.title: Employee sync
requirements.statement: Employees created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; employees made or changed in neome by the Owner are pushed to SAP direct; on a clash SAP wins.
acceptance: An employee added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
An employee added in neome by the Owner is in SAP after the push.

requirements.title: Stock sync from SAP
requirements.statement: Warehouse stock changed in SAP is fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; neome never writes stock to SAP.
acceptance: A stock change in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
A stock change or closing stock made in neome is not sent to SAP.

requirements.title: Invoice to SAP
requirements.statement: An invoice made in neome for a new order is sent by the plugin to SAP at once and is visible in SAP; a failed push is retried and shows Waiting to sync.
acceptance: The invoice of an order placed in neome is visible in SAP within minutes.
With SAP down the invoice shows Waiting to sync and goes when SAP is back.

requirements.title: Plugin set up from neome dashboard
requirements.statement: The Owner sets the plugin in the neome dashboard: SAP connection and sync frequency per data type.
acceptance: The Owner changes the product sync frequency in the dashboard and the next sync follows it.
Only the Owner can change these settings.

requirements.title: Neome builds the plugin
requirements.statement: The Neome team writes the plugin for SAP Business One 10.0 (HANA) over the Service Layer REST API, with credentials from the SAP partner.
acceptance: The plugin is delivered by the Neome team and connects to the 260 Brands SAP through the Service Layer.

requirements.title: Prices, credit limits and open balances from SAP
requirements.statement: The price list per Customer Category, the credit limit and the open balance of each customer are fetched from SAP with the customer and product sync, every 30 minutes.
acceptance: A price changed in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
A customer's credit limit and open balance in neome equal SAP within 30 minutes.

requirements.title: Sync status and failed records
requirements.statement: Each synced record carries a Sync status: Waiting to sync, Synced or Failed; a record SAP rejects shows Failed with the SAP message to the Owner and is retried each cycle.
acceptance: A record SAP rejects shows Failed with the SAP message in the Owner's dashboard.
A Failed record that SAP accepts on a later cycle becomes Synced.

requirements.title: Customer Code from SAP
requirements.statement: Customer Code is the SAP CardCode; a customer made in neome gets a temporary code until SAP returns the CardCode.
acceptance: A customer made in neome shows a temporary code until approved and pushed; after that it shows the SAP CardCode.

requirements.title: Sync log
requirements.statement: The Owner sees a sync log in the dashboard: record, time and Sync status.
acceptance: The log lists each synced record with its time and Sync status.

mapping.how: Customers, products, employees, price lists, credit limits and open balances → Outlet, Warehouse/depot stock and Customer ledger of the field sales App, filled from SAP; plugin built by the Neome team on the SAP Business One Service Layer; Sync setting, Sync record (Sync status Waiting to sync / Synced / Failed) and Sync log added as a new record type; dashboard set-up for frequency; ERP links are never Standard and the App page names no ERP/DMS integration (catalog 4b rule 5, section 5 gap 6); Scope tag Neome as the Neome team builds the plugin. Rests on OI-08, OI-11 (closed)

requirements.title: Role-based access control
requirements.statement: Each user type gets role-based access for their scope. Area Sales Managers see their own area; Regional Sales Managers see their own region and approve leave escalations; Sales Head and Owner see all. The Owner alone has settings.
acceptance: A Sales Supervisor can approve a leave escalation.
A Quality Manager can view all Complaints and change their status, with no other access.
"Supervisor" means Sales Supervisor; "Admin" means Owner. Sales Agents, Tricycle Riders and Sales Supervisors are Employees.
An Area Sales Manager sees only their own area's modules and has no settings or user admin.
A Regional Sales Manager sees only their own region and has no settings.
A Sales Head sees all data and reports and can set targets, with no settings.

requirements.title: Owner full access
requirements.statement: The Owner has full access to all modules, analytics and settings.
acceptance: The Owner can open every module, report and setting.

requirements.title: Area Sales Manager full access
requirements.statement: The Area Sales Manager has access to all modules in their own area, without settings or user admin. The Owner alone has settings.
acceptance: The Area Sales Manager can open each module for their own area only.
The Area Sales Manager cannot open settings or manage users.

requirements.title: Currency and languages
requirements.statement: Use ZMW (Zambian Kwacha), an English app, and Nyanja voice input for NLP.
acceptance: Orders, payments and invoices use ZMW.
The app uses English; NLP voice input supports English and Nyanja.

requirements.title: Hosting and login
requirements.statement: Run on Neome cloud with mobile number and OTP login; no data residency rule applies.
acceptance: Users log in with mobile number and OTP.
Data is hosted on Neome cloud with no residency constraint.

requirements.title: Load existing SAP data
requirements.statement: Existing SAP data is loaded to neome through the plugin at start: customers (about 4,000), products (about 120), employees (about 100) and open balances per customer; no order history.
acceptance: After the first load, the customers, products, employees and open balances of SAP are all in neome.
No SAP order history is in neome.

requirements.title: Training
requirements.statement: Train field staff and supervisors/managers one week before go-live.
acceptance: Field staff get two on-site sessions at Lusaka depot; supervisors and managers get train-the-trainer and short videos.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.statement: Neomenta provides support Mon–Sat, 08:00–18:00 CAT by WhatsApp and email; 260 Brands IT admin is first line.
acceptance: Support is available in the stated hours and channels.

requirements.title: Mobile-responsive for field teams
requirements.statement: The app works well on smartphones and tablets for field teams.
acceptance: Every field form can be filled on a phone screen without sideways scrolling.

requirements.title: Real-time updates
requirements.statement: Data entered in the field shows to supervisors in real time.
acceptance: An order placed by an agent shows in the supervisor's Order Sheet/Report within a minute.
Field visits, orders and attendance work offline and sync when online.

requirements.title: Full implementation scope
requirements.statement: This BRD covers all 34 RFP-1 scope items; all will be built new in neome because the old pilot app is being dropped.
acceptance: All 34 RFP-1 scope items are included for new implementation.

requirements.title: Field operations sizing
requirements.statement: The solution supports about 100 field and management staff, about 4,000 customers, 120 products, 90 Beats, 15 routes, 1,200 visits and 700 orders per day.
acceptance: It supports the stated users, master counts and daily visit/order volumes.

openItems.question: RFP-1 scope table marks 16 items "Completed" and 18 "Pending". Does "Completed" mean already built and live? Should this BRD cover all 34 items or only the Pending ones?
openItems.answer: Completed means built in a pilot app we are dropping; this BRD covers all 34 items and all will be built new in neome.

openItems.question: What access do Regional Sales Manager and Sales Head get? RFP-1 lists both roles with no access.
openItems.answer: Regional Sales Manager: view data and reports for own region and approve leave escalations; Sales Head: view all and reports and set targets. Neither has settings.

openItems.question: Area Sales Manager has "full access to all modules", like the Owner. Any difference (analytics, settings)?
openItems.answer: Area Sales Manager: all modules for own area, no settings or user admin. Only Owner has settings.

openItems.question: Is "Supervisor" in the RFP-1 diagrams the Sales Supervisor? Is "Admin" (Reporting diagram) the Owner?
openItems.answer: Yes to both

openItems.question: Is every Sales Agent and Tricycle Rider also an Employee (clock in/out, leave)?
openItems.answer: Every Sales Agent, Tricycle Rider and Sales Supervisor is an Employee for clock in/out and leave.

openItems.question: How many users per role (Sales Agents, Tricycle Riders, Sales Supervisors, managers)? Volumes: customers, products, beats, visits and orders per day?
openItems.answer: 60 Sales Agents, 25 Tricycle Riders, 8 Sales Supervisors, 3 Area Sales Managers, 2 Regional Sales Managers, 1 Sales Head and 1 Owner; about 4,000 customers, 120 products, 90 beats, 15 routes, 1,200 visits/day and 700 orders/day.

openItems.question: Product Price: one price per product, or prices by customer category or area? Tax on price?

openItems.question: Targets: who sets them, per whom (agent, beat), per period, by value or quantity, per product?
